I'd probably just hook all the windmill axles up to differentials. The speeds of all the shafts would then be "added" together, and differentials aren't particularly inefficient.

You could also have a traditional gearbox on each windmill controlled by a small computer, with speed/torque sensors on each axle, and have them each just drive the same axle.
